subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on July 15th. Your itinerary includes a layover in Paris for 2 hours. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for security checks. If you have any special meal requests or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
